metadata.title: #10. Biomedical Research Funding and Innovation: May 2025 Senate Appropriation Committee Hearing (05/06/2025)
metadata.description: This episode details a Senate Appropriations Committee hearing on the importance of biomedical research for American innovation and public health. The hearing featured discussions on funding stability and the challenges posed by potential caps on indirect costs. Expert testimonies and personal stories highlighted the impact of research on diseases like cancer and ALS, emphasizing the increase in clinical trials and the vital role of the FDA in facilitating new treatments. The hearing also discussed the significance of programs like IDEA in broadening research support and the benefits of global collaborations in addressing health threats.
